description: Fix commit-existence gate false negative: accept any conventional-commit type prefix (not only feat:) before the story id in commitSubjectMatchesStory.

userStories.title: Accept any conventional-commit type prefix in the commit-existence gate
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need commitSubjectMatchesStory to recognize a story-id-bearing commit regardless of its conventional-commit type (fix/refactor/perf/chore/docs/test/build/ci/style, with optional scope or breaking !), so that a story correctly committed as `fix: [US-XXX] - ...` is not falsely reported as no-commit and refused DONE-confirmation even though it is passes:true.
acceptanceCriteria: commitSubjectMatchesStory (src/supervisor/result.ts:360-364) replaces the hardcoded `^feat:` literal with an open conventional-type prefix `^[a-z]+(?:\([^)]*\))?!?:` (any lowercase type, optional scope in parens, optional breaking !). [oracle: grep -Eq '\^\[a-z\]\+' src/supervisor/result.ts]

The existing bracketed-or-bare id alternation `(?:\[id\]|id)` and the trailing `\s*-\s*\S` title-separator requirement are preserved (the feat: literal is the ONLY part changed). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A subject `fix: [US-001] - some title` matches for storyId US-001 (previously false), and subjects using refactor:/perf:/chore:/docs:/test:/build:/ci:/style: prefixes also match. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]
A subject with an optional scope (e.g. `fix(scope): [US-001] - ...`) and one with a breaking marker (e.g. `feat!: [US-001] - ...`) both match. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

The prefix-collision guard still holds: `feat: US-0010 - Title` queried with storyId US-001 does not match (id must be immediately followed by the separator hyphen or closing bracket). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1429-1431 is updated so the `fix: US-001 - ...` case flips from expecting false to expecting true, plus added cases for other conventional types, optional scope, and breaking !. [oracle: grep -q "fix(scope)" test/supervisor/result.test.ts]
The release-side sibling matchers (src/release/bump.ts, src/release/changelog.ts, src/release/ship-pr.ts) are NOT modified. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-concern surgical fix. Files: src/supervisor/result.ts (commitSubjectMatchesStory, line 361-362) and test/supervisor/result.test.ts (existing case at 1429-1431 + new cases). Inline the open `[a-z]+(?:\([^)]*\))?!?:` prefix directly in the regex; do NOT build a new shared module (issue gotcha: reviewer may later decide whether to export/share a const with the release-side patterns, but not in this story). This touches src/ only: no template/vendor/embed change (the implementer prompt's Step 5.5 `fix: [Story ID]` correction commit is what the gate must now recognize, but the prompt template itself is not edited), so embed-vendor:check is NOT required. Gotcha: result.ts:362 is the ONLY story/commit matcher anchored on feat:; the [a-z]+ idiom already used in src/release/bump.ts:24 and changelog.ts:66 is the pattern to mirror. A false negative here yields WorkerOutcomeKind 'no-commit' (result.ts:508,:596), distinct from 'blocked'. noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard any regex capture-group access.
